t: Rawlplug hollow wall anchors provide a robust and permanent anchoring solution for plasterboard. These M5 x 52mm zinc-plated steel fixings are designed for indoor applications, offering a maximum load capacity of 16 kg. Ideal for securely mounting heavy items such as radiators, kitchen cabinets, and televisions, they accommodate wall thicknesses from 6mm to 16mm. Installation requires a 9mm drill bit and a setting tool, ensuring a reliable and fire-resistant hold for various trade projects.
b: Suitable for Hanging Radiators, Kitchen Cabinets & TV Mounting
